items.description: The schema every element of the list must match. Absent means elements of any kind.

minItems.description: Minimum number of elements the list must have.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of elements the list may have.

description.description: What the list is for, when it is written inline; a published schema is described by its page.

params.description: Type parameters that make this schema generic, each with its default schema.

name.description: Legacy: a name some published schemas still carry. New schemas are named by their page.

description: A schema for a list, whose elements match `items` and whose length can be bounded.
